name: posteverywhere
description: Write, schedule and publish social media posts to Instagram, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Facebook, X, Threads, Pinterest, Bluesky, Telegram, Discord and WordPress from a conversation, then see how they performed. Connects the hosted PostEverywhere MCP server.
